card.name: Words inside all-caps boxed warnings
card.fires_on: Words in ALL-CAPS warning text, such as boxed warnings, often a noun like TESTING, CASE or MANAGEMENT, or the middle of a long capitalized word. The pole is negative in these contexts.

modes.label: Nouns after 'the' or a test word
modes.description: A capitalized noun such as TESTING, CASE or MANAGEMENT in an all-caps warning sentence.
modes.example: IT HAS NOT BEEN PROVED THAT PERIODIC SERUM TRANSAMINASE<< TESTING>> WILL PREVENT SERIOUS INJURY

modes.label: Partway through capitalized words
modes.description: A later piece of a long all-caps word, such as -ELY, -ENTION or -NEL.
modes.example: WARNINGS BECAUSE OF ITS MARKED EFFECT ON SODIUM RET<<ENTION>> THE USE OF FLUDROCORTIS
